title: EventJournal construction
requirements: 07.01. `EventJournal[T]` exposes exactly the requested public API.
07.02. Its constructor accepts `maxEntries: int | None = None`.
07.03. A supplied `maxEntries` is validated as an exact integer.
07.05. A supplied `maxEntries` must be greater than zero.
07.06. A newly constructed journal is empty.
